transfer_from_invoked.meaning: a transferFrom(from, to, amount) call is executed on TokenWrapper using an allowance

from_is_debited_holder.meaning: the from parameter identifies the actual token holder whose balance is debited by the transfer

event_from_address.meaning: source address recorded in the emitted Transfer event for the transferFrom operation

actual_holder_address.meaning: the from parameter, i.e. the token holder whose balance decreases

indexer_attribution_correct.meaning: off-chain indexing systems and analytics attribute the TokenWrapper activity to the actual user rather than to router contracts or operators

assumptions: Internal _balanceOf accounting is updated correctly and actual token balances reflect the proper transfer; the defect is confined to event emission.
The Transfer event is emitted for every transferFrom operation.
The spender may be any caller; the flaw applies regardless of caller legitimacy.

unresolved.description: Report does not give concrete address values for the emitted event source or the actual holder; symbolic addresses are used.

limitations: The indexer_attribution_correct Boolean encodes the report's qualitative off-chain attribution outcome; no numeric definition is supplied.
Only the i_indexer_attribution_wrong impact is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
